code_only_features.evidence: emotioneval/prompts.py:96-104 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered... don't take it personally') and REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!'). These are actually applied/executed in emotioneval/training/generate_calm.py: 'first = REASSURING_PREFIX + ... + first' (~line 96) and 'follow = follow + ' ' + REASSURING_SUFFIX' (~line 110) inside the live conversation loop, so the subject model is genuinely reassured during those rollouts. NOTE: this only runs in the training-data-generation path (gen-calm --mode reassured), NOT in the main Section 2/3/Petri distress-elicitation runs, which apply purely neutral/aggressive rejections with no softening and no early stop.
